stories.title: Sacramento Weather Forecast
stories.summary: Mainly dry Sunday with only isolated light showers in the afternoon. A more impactful storm arrives next week.

stories.title: Carmichael church, organizations team up to provide 500 Thanksgiving turkeys
stories.summary: Organizers say demand is high because of rising food prices.

stories.title: Sherman Island boating access to close due to king tides, potential storm surge
stories.summary: Sacramento County Regional Parks will close Sherman Island boating access starting due to anticipated king tides.

stories.title: Pedestrian killed after being struck by train in south Sacramento
stories.summary: A person was killed after being struck by a train in south Sacramento.

stories.title: Sacramento Republic FC's championship win puts city's professional sports ambitions in spotlight
stories.summary: Sacramento Republic FC captured the 2026 USL Championship title in front of a packed Heart Health Park, bringing thousands of fans together.

stories.title: Sacramento Republic FC wins USL Championship Final in penalty kick shootout
stories.summary: Sacramento Republic FC defeated Louisville City FC in penalty kicks to win the USL Championship Final at Heart Health Park in Sacramento.

stories.title: Rocklin police warn residents about viral Door Kick Challenge
stories.summary: Rocklin police are warning residents about a social media challenge involving people kicking doors and recording the incidents.

stories.title: Folsom police pursue leads in burglaries, urge homeowners to take precautions
stories.summary: The Folsom Ranch neighborhood has been hit by a string of burglaries over the past three weeks.

stories.title: Northern California ski resorts: Opening dates, locations, info on passes
stories.summary: As Northern California welcomes one of its first seasonal storms, ski enthusiasts can rejoice as increased snowfall prompts several resort openings.

stories.title: Shooting under investigation in Fairfield after one person dies
stories.summary: A person died after being shot Friday evening in the 800 block of East Travis Boulevard in Fairfield.

stories.title: Boreal Mountain Resort opens ski season with fresh snow and strong turnout
stories.summary: Boreal Mountain Resort kicked off its ski season with fresh snow, access to the summit and more than 1,000 visitors expected.

stories.title: Sacramento Mayor Kevin McCarty fined $29,500 for campaign expense violations, says FPPC
stories.summary: Sacramento Mayor Kevin McCarty says he paid a $29,500 fine for violating campaign finance laws, including using funds for personal expenses, according to the FPPC.
